subject: Interop evaluation — extension & concession request for HelixWorks pilot
messages:
From: Sana Mirza <sana.mirza@helixworks.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@helixworks.com
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: 3-week extension + concession for interop evaluation

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for supporting our interoperability run with Redwood. The integration team uncovered a compatibility issue with our orchestration layer that pushed our end-to-end tests out by ~10 working days. Because of that delay we need an additional 3 weeks on the pilot to finish the interop validation and hit the agreed success criteria.

Given the schedule slip (not caused by functional regressions in Redwood, but by our infra side), we're asking if Redwood can provide either: 1) a 15% concession on the remaining pilot invoice, or 2) convert the unused portion of the reserved hours into milestone credits we can apply against post-pilot integration.

We attached the interop test plan and the timeline showing the delay. We're trying to close procurement approvals this month, so a quick answer would help us avoid another procurement cycle.

Sana Mirza
Head of Integrations — HelixWorks
sana.mirza@helixworks.com
[Attachment: interop_test_plan.pdf (PDF)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Mirza <sana.mirza@helixworks.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week extension + concession for interop evaluation

Hi Sana — thanks for the note and for the transparency on the delay. I reviewed the test plan you attached and it looks like a reasonable ask to finish validation.

I'm going to check with finance and product ops about the two concession paths you outlined (straight invoice discount vs conversion to milestone credits). David, can you run a quick back-of-envelope on revenue impact and whether we can do a hybrid (smaller discount + small milestone credit) to meet HelixWorks procurement timing?

Mina
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
[Sent from mobile]

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 13:40:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: 3-week extension + concession for interop evaluation

Mina / Priya — ran the numbers and sketched two pragmatic options (see attached calc):

Option A — Invoice concession: 15% discount on the remaining pilot invoice (recognizable immediately). This meets HelixWorks procurement preference but reduces short-term ARR.

Option B — Milestone credits: convert unused reserved hours into $-credits that HelixWorks can apply against integration/accelerator work post-pilot. Credits would be recognized as deferred revenue until applied; better for ARR but slower cash accounting.

Hybrid — 10% discount + $2,500 one-time credit for integration hours. This minimizes revenue impact and gives HelixWorks an operational credit to cover integration engineering time.

From a policy standpoint I can approve up to 15% on a one-off with manager sign-off. For credits we need legal to approve addendum language. Procurement timeline matters — if they need an invoice before 12/20 to close FY26, invoice concession is simpler.

Attachment: internal_pricing_calc.xlsx

-David
Sr. Rev Ops Analyst | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: 3-week extension + concession for interop evaluation

Mina / David — from a customer success standpoint, Option B (milestone credits) is preferable — it keeps HelixWorks engaged with clear incentives for integration completion and helps us avoid short-term churn risk if they perceive the pilot as stalled. That said, procurement teams often insist on invoice-level concessions for fiscal deadlines.

I recommend proposing the Hybrid: 10% invoice discount + $2,500 integration credit. That gives procurement something they can show on an invoice and gives the integration team a tangible credit for engineering time. If Legal can turn around an addendum this week, we can meet the 12/20 invoice deadline.

Priya Natarajan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: HelixWorks Procurement <procurement@helixworks.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week extension + concession for interop evaluation

Hi Mina — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement's preference is an invoice-level concession so we can close the change in our financial system this quarter. We can accept a 15% discount on the remaining pilot invoice if Redwood can guarantee issuance of the adjusted invoice before 2026-12-20.

If Redwood prefers credits instead, that will force us into a different approvals path and likely delay execution until January. Unless Redwood can combine both (invoice discount + small credit), procurement will push back on the credit-only option.

Also attaching our standard procurement term sheet where we document change approvals. We will also need SOC 2 evidence to proceed with production connectivity after the pilot (can you confirm your SOC 2 link?).

Thanks —
HelixWorks Procurement Team
procurement@helixworks.com
[Attachment: procurement_term_sheet.docx]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: HelixWorks Procurement <procurement@helixworks.com>, Sana Mirza <sana.mirza@helixworks.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 16:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week extension + concession for interop evaluation

Hi Sana / Procurement — thank you. We appreciate the clarity on your procurement constraints.

Redwood can offer the following compromise to keep you on your timeline and preserve program momentum:

- A 15% discount on the remaining pilot invoice (we will issue the adjusted invoice no later than 2026-12-18).
- A one-time $2,500 milestone credit applied to post-pilot integration/accelerator services (documented in the addendum).

I've asked Legal to draft a short addendum reflecting the discount and credit; we'll generate a DocuSign and share the link today. Also, our SOC 2 report is available here: https://redwood.com/security/soc2 (public report).

If that works, please confirm and we'll route the invoice and DocuSign immediately.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
[Attachment: pilot-addendum-draft.pdf]
